clues.text: God sent Samuel with a horn of oil to this man of Bethlehem, having chosen a king from his sons.
This father had seven sons pass before Samuel, then said the youngest was still out tending the sheep.
When King Saul asked for his son the harp player, he sent a donkey loaded with bread, wine and a young goat.
He sent his youngest son to the Valley of Elah with grain and loaves for the brothers, and cheese for their commander.
Sheba son of Bichri blew a ram's horn and shouted that Israel had no inheritance in this man's son.
Isaiah foretold a shoot springing up from this man's stump, and a Branch bearing fruit from his roots.
Holding Goliath's head, young David told King Saul he was the son of this servant from Bethlehem.
